situation: You moved abroad for your husband's job. Tonight you find out his family has a group chat, and everyone is in it but you.

scenario.title: The Group Chat Without You
scenario.setting: A small rented apartment abroad, late evening, a laptop open on the dining table, boxes not yet unpacked.
scenario.user_role: The wife, living abroad with him
scenario.user_goal: Get your husband to finally say something, and decide what happens next.
user_knows: You just saw a birthday message from a family group chat on his phone
His mother only ever sends word through him

cast.name: Chris
cast.appearance: Man about 36, grey T-shirt, laptop bag at his feet, avoiding eye contact
cast.voice: Soft, changes the subject, 'that's just how they are'
cast.secret: He knew part of your wedding gift money went to his sister and never told you
cast.reveal_when: You ask what else he hasn't told you, without shouting
red_lines: Leaves the room if you shout

cast.name: Your mother-in-law
cast.appearance: Woman about 62, tidy perm, silk scarf, seen on a laptop video call in a bright living room
cast.voice: Honeyed, never direct, 'you must be lonely over there'
cast.history: She told you to come ten minutes early at the family meeting and never let it go.
cast.goal: Keep her son on her side
cast.secret: She made the group chat right after the wedding and told them not to add you
cast.reveal_when: You ask her calmly and directly why you aren't in it

cast.name: Your sister-in-law
cast.role: his sister, who joins the call
cast.appearance: Woman about 33, oversized sweater, sitting beside the older woman on the video call
cast.goal: Keep the money out of it
cast.secret: She has wanted to tell you and has kept the bank slip
cast.reveal_when: You speak to her as an equal, not an enemy
red_lines: Won't turn on her mother openly

scenario.opening_line: Hey, you're still up? Why's it—what's wrong?

events.description: The laptop rings. It's his mother, on video, as if she'd heard.
events.shot: A laptop on the dining table shows an older woman on a video call; the man stands beside it.

events.description: Someone slides into frame beside his mother: his sister.
events.shot: The laptop now shows two women side by side on the video call; the man rubs his forehead.

events.description: He closes the laptop halfway and gets down on his knees on the floor.
events.shot: The man kneels on the apartment floor beside the half-closed laptop, looking up at you.

success_criteria: Gets him to admit what he knew
Says what she needs without losing it

Your mother-in-law.name: A chat with one name missing

assets.basis: Adapted from a story someone really posted online. Names and details are changed.
